action_summary: Restore the two complementary raw-EEG model families using the retained checkpoint paths and their separate normalization/shape contracts, replacing the spectrogram-only execution that coincided with the v15 regression. Remove flip TTA, which worsened the recorded score and changes the w1 input shape, while retaining equal checkpoint probability averaging to approximate the best recorded v13 configuration (0.30219). Sanitize nonfinite electrode values before filtering, use stable normalized exponentiation, fail explicitly for missing checkpoints, and align and validate submission probabilities. This is a history-supported recovery, not a measured new score; no training or inference was run.
